description:
Options are set on each Item, in its **Restaurant** tab: components (Included or Optional), instructions for the kitchen (cooking point) and sections with rules (choose 1, up to 3, 2 free).

An **Option List** holds options shared by many items (Sauces, Cooking point): add it to a section of each item. Sizes are ERPNext Item Variants.
